headline: Fierce Clashes Shake Weathered Expanse and Linn of Mercy Fronts
war_summary: Since our previous dispatch, intense attrition has redoubled along the central and northern sectors, with Weathered Expanse and Linn of Mercy bearing the heaviest toll. In Weathered Expanse, where lines remain fractured with two bases unoccupied, both forces absorbed over 3,500 casualties across the past two hours, punctuated by three fresh base turnovers across contested ground at Crow's Nest and Spirit Watch. Linn of Mercy mirrors this ferocity, enduring nearly 3,500 casualties in two hours and logging four base changes centered on Outwich Ranch and Lathair. While the rapid-fire exchanges in Palantine Berm have moderated from their earlier frenzy, three strategic positions changed hands within the last two hours amidst steady bloodshed. Meanwhile, Stonecradle has awakened into sharp contention, posting two base shifts at Trammel Pool and The Dais as fighting accelerated markedly. To the northwest, Nevish Line sustains a heavy rate of fire with over 1,400 casualties in two hours, though its front has stabilized since morning clashes near Grief Mother. Marban Hollow remains subdued save for a lone turnover at Checkpoint Bua, and outlying sectors have grown quiet.
